截图过窄，仅包含人物上半身背部，缺失下半身及完整动作支撑点，无法完整呈现训练动作全貌。

checks: All candidates from store daily_training labels; references and lifestyle excluded
Every selected source used once; no more than three products per member
Every annotated body/action/contact protection rectangle retained inside its crop
Every PNG/JPG fixed canvas; geometry uses uniform scale with less than half-pixel rounding error
All source hashes unchanged; rejected and ambiguous sources have no product image
All ten products visually inspected on contact sheet; screenshot black bars removed and horizontal action retained
Tone controls stay mild; no person/equipment geometry warp or generative detail
All local gallery links, filters and original/same-crop/output switches verified offline
limitations: Model boxes can miss details; original source and same-crop tone comparison remain visible
Background protection uses a conservative action rectangle, not fine person segmentation
Source-existing body cutoffs are not restored; severely insufficient screenshots are rejected
Multi-person subject confirmation is returned as JSON; review API not integrated
Videos are not sampled; this branch has not yet been approved as a best practice
